title: Hearty Char Grilled Korean Fruit Skillet
description: A roasted and aerated Korean dish featuring a mix of fruit, char-grill-yang, and low-glycemic-friendly ingredients, cooked in an iron teppan vessel.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan vessel over medium heat.
In a large bowl, mix together the pineapple, apple, and pear.
In a small bowl, whisk together the gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, cinnamon, and ginger.
Add the char-grill-yang sauce to the bowl with the gochujang mixture and whisk until combined.
Add the gochujang mixture to the bowl with the fruit and toss until the fruit is evenly coated.
Add the fruit mixture to the preheated iron teppan vessel and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Use a spatula to scrape the bottom of the vessel and redistribute the fruit.
Continue cooking for an additional 5 minutes, or until the fruit is caramelized and slightly charred.
Remove the vessel from the heat and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the fruit mixture warm, garnished with additional cinnamon if desired.
